inlines.v: GESTA'TION, noun [Latin gestatio, from gero, to carry.] 1. The act of carrying young in the womb from conception to delivery; pregnancy. 2. The act of wearing, as clothes or ornaments. 3. The act of carrying sick persons in carriages, as a salutary exercise, by which fevers have often been cured.
